Set and Exhibit Designers plan spatial narratives for exhibitions and scenes, coordinate circulation, visuals, and materials, and use design and construction coordination to turn content into experiences.

paragraphs: In the morning, define narrative and circulation with the curator. At midday, prepare drawings for carpenters and lighting crews. In the afternoon, visit the site to monitor materials and details through several revisions. Before leaving, organize the next day's installation list to keep the exhibition on schedule.

In one sentence: they turn spaces into stories. Their work includes defining circulation, developing visuals, producing drawings, coordinating construction, and monitoring the site. It requires both creative thinking and fieldwork and is central to implementing curatorial concepts.
